name: tgl-motion-graphics
description: Grow Label — a 12-second motion reel built from the website's own design system. Deterministic HTML/SVG frames, true motion blur, procedural soundtrack, rendered to MP4.

scripts.audio: npm run cues && python3 scripts/audio.py out/cues.json out/soundtrack.wav
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run frames && npm run encode
